theorem_contract.classical_baseline: Luks gives deterministic polynomial-time isomorphism for explicit graphs of fixed bounded degree. This module does not implement that algorithm or assign a numerical exponent.
theorem_contract.counting_proof: For cubic bases, each middle vertex has degree 3, each shared edge vertex degree 4; N=7V and E=12V. There are no wire-pair or middle-middle edges.
theorem_contract.cycle_subgroup: The binary incidence kernel acts faithfully by edge-pair flips and even mask translation. Its order is 2^(E-V+c); normality in the full uncolored automorphism group is not asserted.
theorem_contract.scope: This explicit fixed-degree GI family cannot establish superpolynomial classical complexity versus a polynomial quantum algorithm. Polynomial improvements, other tasks and other access models are not excluded.

uncolored_normality_counterexample.scope: One explicit counterexample to full-uncolored normality; the cycle subgroup injection survives.
